Package index

Data Import

Read clinical data files as stored. Type conversion is opt-in via convert_types, because coercing a two-valued numeric to logical breaks 0/1 event and censoring flags.

read_clinical_data()
Read and prepare a clinical dataset in one step

Data Type Conversion

Automatically infer and convert column types, and read back which rule fired on which column.

r_data_types()
Automatically infer and convert data types
type_conversion_report()
Read the per-column type-conversion report

Variable Labels

Extract, look up, register and override variable labels, and declare the code-to-text mappings for coded variables

label_map()
Build a lookup map of data labels
get_label()
Look up the label for a single variable
get_labels()
Look up labels for multiple variables at once
add_labels()
Add or update labels in a label map
apply_label_overrides()
Apply label overrides from a YAML file
apply_value_labels()
Declare value labels for coded variables from a YAML file
clean_labels()
Apply label overrides from a YAML file (deprecated)

dataset_schema()
Column-level schema of a dataset
proc_contents()
Describe a dataset's variables, in the style of SAS PROC CONTENTS
proc_means()
Summarise numeric variables, in the style of SAS PROC MEANS
compare_datasets()
Compare two versions of a dataset

Create or update a dataset manifest file
verify_manifest()
Verify all datasets listed in a manifest

Corpus Inventory

Sweep the job corpus by filename – which studies ran which job types

Candidate Pool Preparation

Getting a covariate list out of a SAS job and into a model without changing the model on the way. Each of these exists because of a failure that was silent: a comment swallowing a variable name, a mean-imputed binary being dummy-coded, a screen spending its step budget on five forms of one concept, a rank-deficient design from two names for the same thing.

sas_variable_block()
Read a variable list out of a SAS job
covariate_audit()
Audit what would happen to each covariate in a model
imputed_levels()
Levels of a column that are not clean integers
covariates_to_numeric()
Apply what covariate_audit() reports
pool_collinear_pairs()
Candidate pairs carrying the same information under unrelated names
concept_of()
The concept a candidate variable belongs to
concept_map()
Map a candidate pool to concepts
prune_to_one_form()
Prune a candidate pool to one form per concept
selection_crowding()
Concepts represented more than once among selected covariates
POOL_AFFIXES POOL_PLAIN_SUFFIX POOL_MIN_STEM
Affix conventions for grouping a SAS candidate pool into concepts
